sonnet.problem: The card says the warning about the tower is "word for word" what Jesus said about the Galileans. No earlier card showed those exact words. Card 5 only gave a paraphrase with a blank ("unless they ___, they too will all perish"), and "No, I tell you" was never shown. The card also mostly repeats what card 7 just answered.
sonnet.rule: What he points out must be true. "Same words" means an exact match. He only points back to words a card has shown.
